text:
COMPLICATIONS OF ACUTE RHINITIS (COMMON COLD, CORYZA)
Complications
- Superimposed bacterial rhinitis
- Suspect this if symptoms last longer than 7-10days
- Sinusitis (suspect with worsening symptoms with facial pain)
- Lower respiratory infection
- Otitis media
- Obstruction of internal auditory meatus: may cause deafness.
